scenario:
stack: vllm
version: 0.31.0
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct

target:
  router: http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/completions
  workers:
    - start: [scripts/vllm-worker.sh, "0", "8001"]
      pid_file: run/vllm0.pid
      health: http://127.0.0.1:8001/health
      iface: lo
      port: 8001
      slowfs_pid_file: run/slowfs.pid
      cgroup: /sys/fs/cgroup/faultline-w0
    - start: [scripts/vllm-worker.sh, "1", "8002"]
      pid_file: run/vllm1.pid
      health: http://127.0.0.1:8002/health
      iface: lo
      port: 8002
      corrupt_pid_file: run/corrupter1.pid

load:
  prompts: prompts/basic.jsonl
  concurrency: 64
  duration: 180s # long enough for a killed worker to reload

faults:
  - type: kill_backend
    target: workers[0]
    at: 20s
    duration: 10s
  - type: hang_backend
    target: workers[0]
    at: 20s
    duration: 10s
  - type: slow_network
    target: workers[0]
    at: 20s
    duration: 10s
    netem: delay 200ms loss 5%
  - type: corrupt_output
    target: workers[1]
    at: 20s
    duration: 10s
  - type: storage_stall
    target: workers[0]
    at: 20s
    duration: 30s # the reload starts on slow storage
  - type: memory_pressure
    target: workers[0]
    at: 20s
    duration: 10s
    memory_frac: 0.8
